experimental-agent-vi.limitation: One agent screened headwords, not all senses or combinations. Human familiarity, recall and entry performance are unmeasured.

experimental-agent-vi-fused.limitation: Internal syllable boundaries are hidden. Shorter representation does not establish easier recall.

experimental-agent-ascii.limitation: Uniform selection does not repair lost Vietnamese semantic distinctions. Human usability is unmeasured.

experimental-agent-distance1.limitation: No NFC codepoint distance-one neighbors in this exact list. Other similarities remain. This does not establish fewer human errors.

control-paired-native.purpose: Matched-index native control for ASCII comparisons
control-paired-native.limitation: Comparison control only. Representatives were chosen by codepoint order, not familiarity. CLI generation is disabled.

historical-vi-v1.limitation: Superseded selection methodology. Retained for reproducible comparisons, not recommended for deployment.

historical-ascii-v1.limitation: Superseded selection methodology and lossy accent folding. Retained for reproducible comparisons, not recommended for deployment.

diagnostic-short-v1.limitation: About 96% of tokens have a codepoint distance-one neighbor. This is a structural count, not a human error rate. CLI generation is disabled.
